€3U. (नेनेक्ति, नेनिंक्ते, प्रणेनेक्ति, निक्त) 
__1 To wash, cleanse, purify; सस्नुः पयः पपुरनेनिजुरम्बराणि [[Śi. 5. 28.]] 
__2 To wash or clean oneself, to be purified (Ā.). 
__3 To nourish. -With निस् to wash, clean, purify; तोयनिर्णिक्तपाणयः [[R. 17. 22]]; [[Y. 1. 191]]; [[Ms. 5. 127.]]

a. [नितरां जायते निजन्-ड] 
__1 Innate, indigenous, native, inborn, congenial. 
__2 Own, one's own, relating to one-self, of one's own party or country; निजं वपुः पुनरनयन्निजां रुचिम् [[Śi. 17. 4]]; [[R. 3. 15]]; 18. 27; [[Ms. 2. 50.]] 
__3 Peculiar. 
__4 Continual, perpetual. -m. (pl.) One's own people. 
-Comp. 
-बोधः Self-knowledge, spiritual knowledge; भिक्षुर्न चाहं निजबोधरूपः [[Hastāmalaka Stotra.]]
